stage.name: Twisted Every Way
stage.description:
You have completely ruined the host's grand performance, and he wants nothing more than to end you right here and now. With all that you have been through on this journey, you feel the same toward him.
Natural DP regeneration is greatly reduced; <'Host's Assistant’> Nearby allies have reduced ATK and continuously receive True damage.
stage.source: mode level file; no stage_table row

leithanian_rebel_leader.name: Leithanian Rebel Leader
leithanian_rebel_leader.flavourText: One of Leithanien's local militia leaders. The widespread popularity of classical Originium Arts has made them more threatening, and their attacks inflict Arts damage.

derisive_audience.name: Derisive Audience
derisive_audience.flavourText: A diehard fan of the Crimson Troupe, they enjoy the performances night and day. They have become as incomprehensible as the troupe itself.

mudrock_matterllurgist.name: Mudrock Matterllurgist
mudrock_matterllurgist.flavourText: A member of Mudrock's Sarkaz squad. Integrating Sarkaz tactics with Leithanian Arts, they are capable of inflicting lethal damage with a block of energy, and prioritize attacking units closest to the contract entrance site.
abilities: Prioritizes attacking units that are vying for control of a 'Gramophone.'

scarlet_singer.name: Scarlet Singer
scarlet_singer.flavourText: A performer of the Crimson Troupe, they unleash their singing voices when sufficiently stimulated, inciting their followers to attack in a frenzy.
abilities: After receiving a certain number of hits, greatly increases all enemies' ASPD for a short period

theater_golem.name: Theater Golem
theater_golem.flavourText: A gigantic golem maintained by the Crimson Troupe's prop department, they are normally used to move bulky items. They are massive and difficult to block.
abilities: Can only be blocked by units with at least 4 Block
Attacks deal Splash damage to allied units in a small area around self

troupe_mouthpiece.name: 'Troupe Mouthpiece'
troupe_mouthpiece.flavourText: The host of the Grand Drama, its mind is completely taken up by its dazzling Arts. The moment it abandoned the Witch King, its curse was deeply etched into the betrayer's spirit. Even so, who cares?
abilities: Attacks 2 enemies simultaneously and inflicts extra Nervous Impairment
Controls <Host's Assistants> in combat. <Host's Assistants> reduce the ATK of and deal continuous True damage to nearby allied units
Loses HP whenever a <Host's Assistant> is killed

wandering_puppet.name: Wandering Puppet
wandering_puppet.flavourText: A musical puppet maintained by the Crimson Troupe's prop department. All who have heard its bewitching melodies have turned as one towards the Crimson Troupe, and were never seen again.
abilities: When not blocked, continuously deals Arts damage to all allied units
